feed.title: They sued over blank Reese's pumpkins. The case was dismissed again
feed.summary: A lawsuit against Hershey regarding the deceptive marketing of Reese's Peanut Butter Pumpkins and other candies has been dismissed for a second time. Plaintiffs alleged the chocolates did not feature the detailed carvings depicted on packaging, leading to "subjective disappointment." The judge sided with Hershey, stating that a "reasonable customer" would understand the images as suggestions and that the plaintiffs did not suffer a financial loss.
